title: FM Rhodes
summary: Two-operator FM Rhodes — bell in the attack over a body that decays out of the way. The lo-fi electric piano.
notes: Two-operator FM at a 2:1 ratio — the bell in the attack that reads as an electric piano, over a body that decays away fast enough to leave room. The modulation index is the character knob: past about 8 it stops being a Rhodes and starts being a bell.
